name: @astilba/cache
description: Portable TypeScript caching with tag invalidation, stale-if-error resilience, and privacy scopes.

scripts.build:apps: pnpm --dir ../../fixtures/cache-react-router run build && pnpm --dir ../../apps/cache-demo run build
scripts.check: for d in . ../cache-harness ../../apps/cache-demo; do (cd $d && oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.ts --disable-nested-config --check . && oxlint --config oxlint.config.ts --disable-nested-config --type-aware --type-check .) || exit 1; done
scripts.fix: for d in . ../cache-harness ../../apps/cache-demo; do (cd $d && oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.ts --disable-nested-config --write . && oxlint --config oxlint.config.ts --disable-nested-config --type-aware --type-check --fix .) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.config.json && tsc -p test/integration/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @astilba/harness --filter @astilba/demo --filter @astilba/rr-fixture -r exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.knip: pnpm --dir ../.. exec knip --workspace packages/cache --workspace packages/cache-harness --workspace apps/cache-demo --workspace fixtures/cache-react-router
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:toolchain && pnpm check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec vitest run && pnpm exec vp test run --project unit --project harness --coverage && pnpm lint:publish && pnpm knip && pnpm knip:production && pnpm build:apps && node scripts/boot-smoke.mjs && node scripts/module-scope-boot.mjs && node scripts/demo-boot-witness.mjs && node scripts/demo-typed-routes.mjs
